reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the limitation of the baseline W–Ta–Cr–V alloy (Cr/V precipitates causing embrittlement) by proposing Hf addition to suppress detrimental phases, uses a physically sound solid-solution strengthening mechanism, and provides a clear, testable falsification experiment without inventing unsupported quantitative predictions. Hypothesis B, while more specific, introduces precise numerical claims (20–30% improvement, 50 nm grain size, 1100 °C, 9% He) that are not directly supported by the cited evidence and may overextend the mechanism's known boundaries.
